summary: Broadcast one final replication wake when the worker retires its filesystem watcher, covering writes whose kernel events have not reached the wake channel.

schema.detail: No durable schema, client API or wire protocol changes.

rules.detail: Both successful and failed worker returns queue a final dirty generation before the bounded wake drain. It coalesces with pending watcher-delivered generations.

compatibility.detail: The existing two-second drain bound and original worker error are preserved; no peer changes are required.

downtime.detail: No coordinated restart or migration is required.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes; ordinary binary rollback applies.
